steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: Grandma...

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: I don't understand...

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: You're not getting away this time, bloody pup.
As the Carnevale drew to a close and the dust settled in the square last night, Lyudmila spotted a familiar red silhouette.
She followed the figure through winding alleys—sometimes hitting dead ends, other times standing still. It clearly had no direction.
Lyudmila readied for an ambush, biding her time. Her strike landed true.
She pinned the figure down, pressing her blade against its heart. Just a little more, and she would avenge her mentor and end this haunting ghost.
But the red Lupo offered no resistance. She simply knelt, muttering as she stared into space.
Lyudmila looked into her eyes and saw nothing but emptiness. The silence was brief, and the red lupo spoke—

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: ...True wolf.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: Grandma was the true wolf...

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: I was like them, chosen by the true wolf...

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: We hunt for the true wolf, die for the true wolf, deliver the true wolf's victory...

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: The story was a lie... Grandma was a lie...

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: It's all a lie...

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: You're talking about your game?

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: So Maestro had to live in fear all her life with a limp leg, just because she's part of this stupid game?

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: You killed her for this 'victory'?!

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: I don't understand—
Lyudmila suddenly feels a force from her counterpart, and hears the sound of blade ripping through fabric.
She takes a step back.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: Is this what your Kal'tsit taught you?

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: Violence, hatred, ideals, fate... your Kal'tsit always has an explanation, doesn't she?

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: Kal'tsit... Kal'tsit...
The kneeling, red-garbed Lupo searches through her clothes in the rain, eventually pulling out a tooth from where Lyudmila's knife had struck.
It's a small, sharp tooth. The knife has left a clear mark on it.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: A baby tooth?

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: Grandma told me that this kind of tooth falls out because it can't tear the prey's flesh.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: But I have always kept it... not sure why.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: Kal'tsit said I should keep it safe, until I know the answer...

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: I didn't listen to Kal'tsit...

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: I found the girl with the bow.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: She's alive. You missed her vital organs.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: Did you doubt yourself in the final moments, scum?

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: Do you want to see this Kal'tsit of yours?

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: (Waggles ears silently)

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: Well, I'm going to find her and ask her what all this is about.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: Don't you dare die before then.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: And don't you dare get my knife dirty.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: Is this how Nuova Volsinii's law enforcement does things?

steps.name: Police Officer
steps.text: As we have already explained to you multiple times, Signor Saluzzo...

steps.name: Police Officer
steps.text: Your request for legal counsel is perfectly lawful and reasonable. We duly notified Saluzzo Vino, but nobody has come... It's not because of any interference on our part.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: I want to see your supervisor. No, I want Justice Lavinia, or Mayor Leontuzzo.

steps.name: Police Officer
steps.text: Umm...

steps.name: Police Officer
steps.text: Uh?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Buongiorno, Signore. Had a bad night?

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: Lappland?

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: You have been banished from the Saluzzos forever, traitor. You do not have the right to rescue me.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Oh please, old thing, still so full of yourself.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Do I look like I'm here to rescue you?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Catch.
Lappland throws an elaborate gift box through the cell door window.
Alberto does not catch it. The gift box falls to the ground, its lid coming off and revealing a new suit—briskly cut, elaborately embellished, even more so than Lappland's outfit.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: How do you like it? Meant it to be a gift for the Carnevale. The work of a master Siracusan tailor.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: We already said goodbye last year, dear father, so I wasn't planning to see you again. I preferred to spend my time on more meaningful things.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: But then, it would be ungrateful of me to not present a parting gift, after all the lessons you taught me...

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: But the little tailor who was supposed to run errands got into a little problem, so I had to make this trip myself.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Unfortunately, the Carnevale has already come to a close...

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: But from the looks of things, you need something to wear for prison, don't you? Haha.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: Are you trying to provoke me?

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: It won't work, Lappland.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: How can you be so clever yet so childish? Every Saluzzo knows that Alberto Saluzzo is never wrong—

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Tsk-tsk.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Well, since I'm here, let me tell you one other thing...

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Let's just say... your stay will be much longer than you think.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: ...What?

steps.name: Famiglia Lawyer
steps.text: The vote has been taken, Signorina Lappland.

steps.name: Famiglia Lawyer
steps.text: Despite your mistakes, you are the don's only daughter, and the heir to Famiglia Saluzzo.

steps.name: Famiglia Lawyer
steps.text: We need you to take charge of the famiglia's affairs for now. The most urgent tasks are responding to City Hall's investigation of Saluzzo Vino after the Carnevale and getting the don out.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: What? I was just here for a drink.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: I thought there are no famiglie in Nuova Volsinii. Are you sure you want to play this inheritance game?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Besides, didn't the old man pick his guy before he went in?

steps.name: Famiglia Lawyer
steps.text: Do you mean...

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: If you're looking for help, you should look for it from Saluzzo Vino's primary partner.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: I am honored to take on this responsibility, Signorina Lappland... and my friends from Saluzzo.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: So, what's the plan?

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: We will immediately audit all our businesses in the city, in accordance with the New Urban Management Act.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: In addition to illegal registration, if Signor Saluzzo has indeed been manipulating Saluzzo Vino to engage in prohibited activities, it is our duty to gather materials and self-report to City Hall.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: If necessary, I will restructure the leadership of Saluzzo Vino.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: A necessary sacrifice, to protect Saluzzo Vino.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Oh my, that sounds like so much hard work. Here's a toast to you.

steps.name: Famiglia Lawyer
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: How dare Bellone... did he plan this from the beginning?

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: You would allow the Bellones to take the Saluzzos' business in Nuova Volsinii—

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Remember what you said? 'Banished from the Saluzzos forever,' right?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Or did you think I was going to come home to roost, like a migratory fowlbeast?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: There was always a question on my mind, PAPA.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Why were you so angry when I tried to kill the Bocche al Lupo at Brunello, or when I let Texas go in Columbia?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Were you angry that I acted against the famiglia's interests, violated the rules of Siracusa...

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Or were you just angry that I was telling everyone that there are certain things which are outside Alberto Saluzzo's control?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: You should probably save your strength for the trial. I doubt the new management of Saluzzo Vino would make his legal counsel available for you.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: My dear father, you're not just a fool, you're a boring fool.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: It's really addio this time. But cheer up!

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: You'll be better-dressed than all your fellow inmates, after all...

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Hey, ain't you done yet?

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: I don't know what the paper pushers at City Hall are thinkin'. Same points, same social service, but why I gotta sweep two more streets than you, Capone?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: That's SIGNOR Capone to you, Gambino. Don't forget who saved you when you passed out in the alley that night.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Vaffanculo.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Did you hear? Half of Venezia Trucking's management are in police custody right now.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: It wasn't just cigar and vinyl sent to Venezia Senior's room that night. There were also detailed business and personnel records of Venezia Trucking for the past year.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Anyone who was closely associated with Venezia Junior got rooted out, and the City Hall cazzi came into work the next day to a thick pile of self-reports lying on their table.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Venezia Senior cut ties so swiftly and decisively that City Hall couldn't find fault. Venezia Trucking will get a full makeover but won't be shut down. Venezia Junior's impact was reduced to a minimum.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: The famiglie sure are finding new and... clever ways of dealing with traitors in Nuova Volsinii.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: The don really struck like thunder, didn't he? I thought he came for the festival.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: We'd've been rotting behind bars by now, if we'd listened to you and stayed there.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: What's the difference?

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: We lost all our citizen points, and we gotta start again from scratch... once again, we got nothing left.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Well, not exactly nothing...
Capone casts his gaze at the intersection, where a familiar yellow cab is parked.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Lappland said we can have the cab... our reward, basically.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: How long do you think it'll take before we get a taxi company started in this city? I know what we'll call it. Taxi Siciliano. Whaddya think?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: ...I think we should get outta here, because that judge is coming.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Wait, I don't think she's coming for us—

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: You're just going to leave without saying anything?

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: Lavinia.

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: I won't stay any longer. Don't want to keep you up at night.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Where will you go?

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: Rhodes Island, maybe? Haven't seen Lisa in a while.

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: Now that this old score has been settled, I have the time, and the mood.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: I'm not here for small talk, Signora Venezia. We're not that close to begin with.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Earlier in the morning, Venezia Senior came to see me and Leontuzzo...

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: Whatever is going on with Venezia is none of my business—

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: He would pay any price for Venezia Trucking's survival, even if it's just one factory but he also had another request—to grant you safe passage out of Nuova Volsinii.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Given the actions of Venezia Junior on the night of the Carnevale, your efforts helped City Hall contain the violence to some extent. Therefore, leniency should be considered.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: However, the charges of assault and battery still stand, not to mention that your actions were acts of revenge within a famiglia.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: We will issue an arrest warrant for you, Signora Venezia.

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: Arrest warrant?

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: I have multiple mafioso bounties on me, and even Signora Sicilia's prohibition... the arrest warrant will be a nice souvenir, I guess.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Do not dismiss it so casually, Signora Venezia.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: This arrest warrant is empowered by the New Urban Management Act. Unlike Signora Sicilia's prohibition, there is no room for mediation just because some famiglia comes into power or loses it.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: The law is the law, Signora Venezia. We've talked about this before.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Your every move will be watched by Nuova Volsinii, and perhaps all of Siracusa in the future. The arrest warrant will remain valid until you are brought into custody.

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: I appreciate the reminder, Lavinia.

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: I'm not dismissing your declaration. I could tell that you're a firm person when I saw you at the winery.

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: In the Siracusa I knew, you didn't need a reason to kill. But that's not how things should be. Every action needs a reason—a proper reason.

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: It's true for judges, for mothers... even for killers.

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: I approve of your reason, which is why I approve of your action. Besides, as I've told you, I don't have anything against your profession.

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: I'm just thinking... if you issued a warrant for me...

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: Should I look forward to when we meet again?

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: Well, I should go.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: ...Hello, Eirene.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Are you feeling better, Signor Bellone?

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Yes. Thanks for asking.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: There is something I need to give you.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: ...A resignation letter?

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: I-I would like to resign as president of the Truckers' Union.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: One year ago, I promised you and Judge Lavinia that no mafioso would infiltrate the Truckers' Union... but I failed to keep the promise.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: I stopped them from putting their people in the union, but it didn't prevent them from achieving their goal at all.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Sommer, and all the others whom they used... it's my fault. And I tried to coerce Judge Lavinia when things were exposed.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: It's not your fault. Not all of it, at least.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: No one can stay calm when they see their best friend die and their family, along with themselves, backed into a corner.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: In the end, little harm was done.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: But I just can't forgive myself...

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: I received a joint letter just before you arrived.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: It was signed by two hundred full-time drivers of the Truckers' Union, plus several hundred more temporary and contract staff, asking for amnesty towards your actions during the Carnevale.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Th-They shouldn't have...

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Rethink your resignation, Eirene.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: City Hall will hold an internal hearing next week to discuss integrating the Truckers' Union as a government department alongside City Development and the police.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Together, we will build Nuova Volsinii's logistics and the city itself, Eirene. I look forward to a long and productive partnership with you.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: I still trust the decision that Lavinia and I made that day. You may or may not be the best person to lead the Truckers' Union, but you're a decent person.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: In the two days since I woke up, I've learned about what I missed, and thought about many things.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Finding the direction is easy. It's the journey that's hard—a long, long journey.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: How did it go?

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: The association will need to cooperate with the investigation and face penalties. However, City Hall won't pursue what happened during the Carnevale or those who helped with the smuggling.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: Good.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: I thought I asked you to wait for me at the camp.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: I came to say goodbye. Didn't want to deal with the commotion if I said it at the camp.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Y-You're leaving?

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: I found the red one. She's not in great shape...

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: I thought she was your sworn enemy.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: Yes. She needs to go back to somebody, and that somebody is my other sworn enemy, whom I'll have to visit sooner or later...

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: It's a long story. Anyway, if nothing much is going on with the Union for the time being, I want to visit this place called Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: There's something I want to ask before I leave.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: That night, when you ordered us to point our weapons at the Venezia mafiosi... what were you thinking?

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: That all of the Union's problems will go away if we kill those bastards?

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: And who smuggled what will remain a secret forever?

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: Were you confident that it could be done, with so many people behind you, and so many weapons in our hands?

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: Were you confident that you wouldn't be held responsible?

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: Were you thinking about protecting the people behind you, or how, like the bastards on the other side, you held the fates of so many in your hands?

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: Was it the gunshot that made you stop... or was it your judgment from deeper down?

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: No need to tell me, Eirene. You know the answer.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: I told you the story of Talulah, a respected leader who became an evil dragon. I failed to see it happen, and I didn't kill her.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: I won't make the same mistake again. I'm watching you, Eirene. I'm the sword that hangs above your head.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: If that's what you become, I will come for you, no matter where I am... and I will kill you.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: I hope that day never comes. I hope we can truly, sincerely, give each other our blessings... friend.
Eirene is alone. The Reproba with the furrowed brows has vanished without a trace.
The night wind of late autumn is chilly, but Eirene just stands there, lost in thought.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: It's me, Sandro.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: About the joint letter... thank you.

steps.name: Zaaro
steps.text: I thought you promised Texas to take us away from Siracusa.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Haha, I lied.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Besides, did she really win the bet?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Is the Carnevale over, Zaaro? Or has it just begun?

steps.name: Zaaro
steps.text: The old wolf of Venezia has hidden his fangs and claws, blending back into the pack. The pup named Eirene has learned the tricks of hunting on her own...

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: That's why I said you guys are stupid.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: You set all sorts of dumb rules, but you can't resist breaking them.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: The game becomes increasingly boring with each cycle. The all-powerful Signori dei Lupi are reduced to petty worries, like humans.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: From one wolf to another, tell me, Zaaro, what set the revelry beneath us into motion.

steps.name: Zaaro
steps.text: Power, obviously.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Yes. A port, a community, a city... wherever there are people, there is power.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Whether one pursues it, detests it, seeks to control it, or grasps it like a drowning man clutching at straws...

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: They all end up holding power tight and wielding it with fervor.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Power is the true wolfpack. It's the game all Siracusans… no, all HUMANITY was born playing.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: There is no judge, no rules... its variety is infinite, and it does not end except by death.

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: Like the wind on the wilderness, there is no direction, and no one knows where it comes from... but it never stops.

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: Interesting. Very interesting indeed.

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: I'll concede that you have discovered this pleasure earlier than us. Do you intend to put an end to the Fangs, and have Lappland lead us into this new game?

steps.name: Zaaro
steps.text: That depends on what Vargo, Agnese, and the ones over there who haven't spoken think.

steps.name: Agnese
steps.text: No human has ever been the alpha of the pack in the memory of the Signori dei Lupi... nay, of the Beast Aristocrats.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Do you have a hierarchy over here?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: That's a human concept to shackle their own brethren. You call yourselves the Signori dei Lupi; act like one.

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: If she truly does bring us pleasure...

steps.name: Vargo
steps.text: ...There's one more thing you forgot.

steps.name: Vargo
steps.text: Look at the crystals on her leg. She's pretty far gone, and Oripathy is an uncurable disease for humans. Will we, deathless Signori dei Lupi, recognize a dying human as alpha?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: True, I probably don't have much time left.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Doesn't that add to the thrill of the game?

steps.name: Zaaro
steps.text: I have a feeling.

steps.name: Zaaro
steps.text: That this is going to be the best time of my life.

steps.name: Agnese
steps.text: Oh, and Emperor came to talk to me.

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: It's not just the pack that has sensed this unease... it is a crisis that has put all the Aristocrats of Beasts on guard.

steps.name: Agnese
steps.text: Emperor and our cousins in other races wish to talk to us.

steps.name: Agnese
steps.text: If Lappland is our alpha, then...

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: There is no rest for the wicked, is there?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Tell them...

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: The wilderness keeps its promises.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Wait for me.

steps.name: City Hall Staff
steps.text: Please take a look, Signorina Texas. I'll submit it if there's no issue.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: There's so much paperwork to become an independent consultant for you guys?

steps.name: City Hall Staff
steps.text: Mi scusi.

steps.name: City Hall Staff
steps.text: The Carnevale drew a large number of tourists and delivered on the promotional expectations. Nuova Volsinii Port has received a large number of orders in recent days...

steps.name: City Hall Staff
steps.text: Moving forward, our logistics systems will reach beyond Nuova Volsinii, connecting with other cities in Siracusa, and even abroad. There is no room for negligence.

steps.name: City Hall Staff
steps.text: Penguin Logistics has the qualities we're looking for, but Lungmen is a long way from here. The process for bringing you on as a special consultant will be a little more complicated.

steps.name: City Hall Staff
steps.text: Just sign here!

steps.name: City Hall Staff
steps.text: Welcome to Nuova Volsinii, Signorina Texas. Things are about to get busy.
Excuse me, could you submit my application with Cellinia's?

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: We meet again, Cellinia.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Giovanna?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I thought you wouldn't be coming back for a while after you left for Columbia.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Has your journey for inspiration come to a close?

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: Sora started her second Siracusa tour two months ago, didn't she?

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: Did you notice the name 'Caterina Culture Ltd.' on the sponsor list?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Since when have you become so close with Sora?

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: She's a friend, too. One whom you introduced me to.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: My injuries have healed, and I've found new inspiration. It was time to come back.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: The happy times of the past may be gone, but that doesn't mean we can't create even happier stories ourselves. I needed time to prepare before...

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: Now, I'm ready.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: And none too soon, I see. It seems like you have made a decision, too.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Yes. Things will be different between us now.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: I'm looking forward to it, Cellinia.

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: Zzz...

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Father? Father Agenir?

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: Oh, it's you.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: I wouldn't have realized that you were in Nuova Volsinii, if I didn't see your photo in the submissions for memories of the Carnevale.

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: Well, I didn't tell you. Or anyone else, for that matter.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Are you planning to leave now?

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: I'll go back to Montelupe with you. There are certain things that I should explain to Signora Sicilia personally.

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: This city is just entering its second year. Its mayor has many things to attend to.

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: Take it easy, young man.

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: I'm loath to admit that we're like concerned parents who quietly follow their children the first time they go out on their own...

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: But yes, I came to this city at Sicilia's behest.. to see it, deal with some people or declare a decree on her behalf, if it comes to that.

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: But I did nothing. The Carnevale had its little hiccups, but it's come to a satisfactory conclusion, hasn't it?

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: In certain ways, it's true that you haven't completely fulfilled your promise to Sicilia, to transform Nuova Volsinii into a new city that's totally different...

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: I can't deny it.

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: Well, Sicilia had so much more on her plate when she first came back to Siracusa. It wasn't easy, bringing guns and order to this country.

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: Of course, you're facing more resistance than she did. That's why she wouldn't pour cold water on the fire of youth... she hasn't gotten that old.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: I'm not coming back with you to Montelupe to prostrate myself before Signora Sicilia and beg for her mercy.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: I have some plans about the future of Nuova Volsinii, about promoting the New Urban Management Act...

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: Ah. Very good, then.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: I want to ask, though... if you came to deal with problems, why didn't you do anything?

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: I saw an old friend.

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: How long has it been, Umberto?

steps.name: Umberto
steps.text: ...Father Agenir?

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: I remembered that you moved to Nuova Volsinii. Just thought I would drop by.

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: Are you waiting for someone?

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: Mafia killers? Or the Fangs?

steps.name: Umberto
steps.text: I don't know. But death will find me, one way or another.

steps.name: Umberto
steps.text: I'm old enough.

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: Sorry, it's been a long time since I walked into a church, or offered a prayer for the dying.

steps.name: Umberto
steps.text: Some priest you are... I still remember the day we met.

steps.name: Umberto
steps.text: It never occurred to me in a thousand years that I would be hired to kill a Sankta, a priest no less. A moment of surprise was enough for you to pull a gun from your robes...

steps.name: Umberto
steps.text: I would never have gone back to being a tailor, if not for you.

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: All in the past.

steps.name: Umberto
steps.text: Why have you chosen to come to Nuova Volsinii tonight? Is the Carnevale—

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: Any final wishes, Umberto? I'll see what I can do.

steps.name: Umberto
steps.text: No, Father.

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: None at all?

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: I remember you have a grandson... Luchino, is it?

steps.name: Umberto
steps.text: There's only so much I can do for him.

steps.name: Umberto
steps.text: To me, he's my only family. To him, there will be a day when I'm not his only family anymore...

steps.name: Umberto
steps.text: The future awaits the young.
